IQM完成与RAAQ的业务合并，成为首家在美国大型交易所上市的欧洲量子计算公司
7月2日，在与Real Asset Acquisition Corp.正式完成业务合并后，IQM Quantum Computers正式在纳斯达克全球精选市场以代码“IQMX”开始首日公开交易。此次公开亮相标志着欧洲量子硬件开发商首次在美国主要证券交易所上市。在最终确定的3.37亿欧元（3.85亿美元）形式现金支持下，这家总部位于芬兰埃斯波的公司进入公开市场，立即准备流动资本，以扩大其垂直整合的供应链，加速其全栈超导处理器的商业推广。

谷歌量子AI等在量子处理器上首次观测无无序局域化
本研究构建了初始态为所有无序构型叠加的量子线路（在格点规范场论中视为规范扇区叠加），以降低量子多体无序系统中无序采样的代价。实验中，一、二维晶格均观测到无无序情况下的反常局域化：微扰被抑制扩散。但熵测量显示，叠加制备态与直接无序采样态存在根本差异。基于该叠加态，提出对无序构型采样具有多项式加速的算法，回应了多体局域化研究的长期难题。研究成果于7月2日发表于《Science》（科学）。
来源：
https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adr9680

微软加速抗量子计划，
2029
年前实现全部过渡
6月30日，
微软宣布全面加速其抗量子安全计划（
QSP），目标在2029年前将关键产品与服务级联过渡至后量子密码（PQC）标准。鉴于量子计算研发的加速可能使“具密码学相关性的量子计算机（CRQC）”提前问世，加之“先收集、后破解”的长期数据窃取风险增加，微软认为政企机构必须即刻行动。为此，微软正将PQC指标全面纳入“安全未来倡议”（SFI），并聚焦三大工程优先级：推动网络密码基线升级（如普及TLS 1.3）、为静态数据构建“密码敏捷性”（Crypto-agility）底层架构，以及现代化身份、签名和证书等密码信任链。

## Google Quantum AI and Others Observe Disorder-Free Localization for the First Time on a Quantum Processor

This study constructed quantum circuits whose initial states are superpositions of all disorder configurations (interpreted as superpositions of gauge sectors in lattice gauge theory), thereby reducing the cost of disorder sampling in quantum many-body disordered systems. Anomalous localization in the absence of disorder was observed in both one- and two-dimensional lattices: perturbations exhibited suppressed diffusion. However, entropy measurements revealed a fundamental difference between the superposition-prepared state and directly disorder-sampled states. Based on this superposition state, the authors proposed an algorithm offering a polynomial speedup for sampling disorder configurations, addressing a longstanding challenge in many-body localization research. The results were published on July 2 in *Science*.

On June 29, SRI announced that it will establish a Quantum Manufacturing Engineering Center (QMEC) through an expanded collaboration with NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology), with the goal of scaling up the production of U.S. quantum components and systems. The center will initially focus on manufacturing challenges related to cryostats, lasers, quantum chips, integrated photonic circuits, standards, quality control, and the domestic supply chain. The company evaluated three machine learning models — BPNN, RBFNN, and GRNN — finding that RBFNN and GRNN achieve higher prediction accuracy in high-dimensional parameter spaces, while BPNN offers the fastest computation speed. On June 30, Microsoft announced a comprehensive acceleration of its Quantum Safe Program (QSP), with the goal of transitioning key products and services to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards in a cascading manner before 2029. Citing the possibility that accelerating quantum computing R&D could bring forward the arrival of a "cryptographically relevant quantum computer" (CRQC), as well as the growing risk of long-term "harvest now, decrypt later" data theft attacks, Microsoft believes that government and enterprise organizations must act immediately. At the event, the Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission, Xuhui District, and the Shanghai Academy of Sciences jointly launched the "Quantum Computing Future Industry Cultivation Zone," implementing the strategic directives of the Municipal Party Committee and Municipal Government through coordinated city-district action and multiple measures to jointly cultivate the quantum computing industry. The conference focused on topics including scientific frontiers, technical pathways, engineering validation, application scenarios, and industrial ecosystem development, helping to unlock the critical link between quantum computing and commercialization.

## South Korea Launches Post-Quantum Cryptography Training Program, Aiming to Cultivate 620 Professionals This Year

On June 30, according to *Digital Today*, South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT and the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA) announced the operation of a "Post-Quantum Cryptography Professional Training" program from July to November. The training program comprises three types of courses: development, migration, and practice. The development and migration courses will each enroll 90 participants, while the practice course will enroll 440, for a total of 620 participants, with the aim of accelerating the talent pipeline for national migration to post-quantum cryptographic standards.

## University of Central Florida Scientists Develop New Method to Reduce Quantum Computing Errors

On July 1, Han Zhao, an assistant professor at the University of Central Florida (UCF), is developing a new method that uses tiny mechanical vibrations and superconducting systems to make quantum operations more resistant to noise and errors, addressing one of the greatest challenges in quantum computing. Supported by the Ralph E. Powe Junior Faculty Enhancement Award from Oak Ridge Associated Universities, Zhao's research employs a topological "braiding" approach — analogous to tying knots — to stabilize quantum states by focusing on global patterns. The project leverages UCF's advanced quantum infrastructure and aims to improve the reliability of quantum systems, contributing to future breakthroughs in fields such as medicine, energy, and advanced materials.
